name: flat_pattern_in_the_drawing
why: ENTRY GT13. The L of the sheet-metal cases (30 + 50, thickness 2, radius 2, depth 40) put on the drawing FLATTENED: the view that serves whoever cuts the sheet blank. Measured with the little test rig on 26/9/2026: the view is born at the first attempt, with a bend line; its outline (`GetOutline`) said 51.88 x 92.592 mm for a flat pattern of 80.712 x 40 — it contains the bend note and a margin. The bounding box is read from the visible edges.
defect_caught: The view that is born but is not flattened (the bent L instead of the flat pattern), the view that measures something different from the flat pattern of the part, and the measure taken from the outline of the view instead of from the drawing.

expect.why: the view attaches to the FILE of the part
IsFlatPatternView: the flattened sheet metal, not the L

expect.tolerance_why: the edges sampled and brought onto the sheet: a hundredth is far less than what would separate the bent L (50 or 30) from the flat pattern
expect.why: the long side: 30 + 50 minus the two bend corrections, the same number as the part
two independent readings: the view on the sheet and the body of the flattened part
SEEN IN THE PNG on 26/9/2026, with the rest of the case green: put at 300/90 at scale 2:1 the view went down into the title block. Now it goes in a free place, outside the views and the title block
